professionalSummary.text: Maintains the statutory inspection calendar and chases overdue inspections with contractors.
professionalSummary.witness: kept the statutory inspection calendar for 48 client sites in the CAFM system and chased contractors whenever a lift, fire-alarm or gas-safety inspection passed its due date.

experienceHighlights.text: Audits subcontractor permits to work and method statements before work starts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Checked subcontractor permits to work for roof access and hot works against the method statement before the job was released, and returned incomplete permits to the contractor with the missing items marked.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Investigates site incidents with area managers and records corrective actions to closure.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Worked on incident investigations with the area managers, interviewing site staff, photographing the scene and entering the corrective actions in the incident log, then following each action until it was closed.

skills.text: Prepares the quarterly compliance report for client account managers.
skills.witness: Scheduled the monthly toolbox talks for cleaning operatives across the northern sites and filed the signed attendance sheets.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in maintaining statutory inspection calendars, auditing subcontractor permits, investigating site incidents, and preparing compliance reports. They also confirm the candidate holds a NEBOSH National General Certificate. The materials do not establish the candidate's ability to prepare quarterly compliance reports for client account managers, as the evidence only mentions monthly toolbox talks.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's qualifications and experience are partially supported by the provided materials, and further human review is required to assess suitability for the role.
